text: Does anyone have a videographer they'd recommend for listing videos? Need someone reliable with a quick turnaround, doesn't have to be crazy expensive. TIA!
comment_source_reason: Direct request for a video/videography provider inside a realtor group — the video pros who answer are exactly who an automated video-editing app is built for (they compete with it), and the realtors chiming in about their own filming/editing pain also market themselves and are the app's core buyer.
